title: The leftover
summary: Each quiet moment, only a fraction of the water remains.

cards.lead: No new pour. Just a quiet moment.

cards.plain: You just watched a quiet moment keep only part of the water.
cards.name: That leftover fraction is called beta.

question.prompt: Beta is 1/2. You have 6. After one quiet moment, with no pour, what is left?
question.simpler: Multiply by the leftover fraction. Nothing was poured.

question.prompt: A beta near 1 means the bucket forgets slowly.
question.why: Almost all the water stays, so the memory is long.
question.simpler: 1 would keep everything. 0 would empty it at once.

recall.question: If half the water stays, and you had 8, what is left after a quiet moment?

deeper.note: In code, beta is that fraction per step. The snnTorch walk-through is tutorial 2, beside the Eshraghian paper’s neuron section.

paper.title: Training Spiking Neural Networks Using Lessons From Deep Learning

terms.definition: How much of the previous voltage remains after one timestep, before the new input is added.
